name: fr.amacunia/france-condominium-syndic-mandate-end
title: France Condominium Syndic Mandate End Sentinel
description: Who is a French condominium's syndic, and when does its mandate end? By condominium or by area.

tools.name: syndic_example
tools.description: Free sample: a real condominium record and an extract of a real list of mandates ending soon. Same shapes as syndic_lookup and syndic_echeances.

tools.name: syndic_lookup
tools.description: Use this when you need to know who manages a French condominium (its professional syndic) and when that syndic's mandate ends. For 1 to 50 condominiums (registry number, e.g. AA2002871): the syndic with SIRET, the declared end of its mandate (3 years max, art. 28 decree 67-223), days left, status, lots, address, from the official ANAH registry (656,000 condominiums, updated daily). For syndics, insurers, building contractors. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (x402). Free trial: set free_trial to true (3 calls per day per caller).

free_trial.description: Set to true to ask for the free trial (3 calls per day per caller, shared with the web route, within a daily cap for the service). Without it, the tool asks for an x402 payment.

tools.name: syndic_echeances
tools.description: Use this when you need to know which French condominiums in an area have a syndic mandate ending soon. One call returns up to 100 condominiums for a commune (INSEE code), postal code, department or a syndic's SIRET and a date window (default next 6 months), sorted by mandate end date, with the current professional syndic, number of lots and address, from the official ANAH registry. For property managers, insurers and contractors building prospect lists. Price: 0.03 USDC per call (x402).

avant.description: Window end, default today + 180 days (window of 2 years at most)
